source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보팩에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The actual requester asks for independent randomized complex concept tests and use of the attached image. I independently chose a botanical-workroom material experiment: a fictional 27-year-old art performer shows artificial heart prints over both pupil regions and a clearly specified below-navel pigment topology in one photograph. The 27-year-old role, nonsexual art scope, lens carrier, body marking geometry and exact topology are agent/coordinator-authored test design, not user definitions, actual reference-person facts, or universal prototypes for slang. The reference guides visible face/hair appearance only. The quiet inspection moment connects freshly applied pigment with matching cut-paper shapes. The viewer first sees a composed face, then the eye detail and pigment carrier, then the workshop context. Two considered directions were a more distant installation portrait and a close surface-inspection portrait; the latter makes the two test regions inspectable without changing their carriers.
subject: A fictional 27-year-old woman portrayed as an adult art performer; reference-guided visible face and hair only.
setting: A glass-roof botanical workroom with a plant bench and geometric transfer materials.
event: A frontal still inspection portrait as freshly applied geometric pigment settles.
visual_priorities: Two clearly resolved artificial crimson heart lens prints centered over the visible black pupil regions in otherwise ordinary open eyes.
A deep-blue four-element mirrored pigment design adheres to the same performer lower-abdominal skin four centimeters below her visible navel.
The calm frontal performer and matching cut-paper shapes make one coherent workshop experiment.
Diffuse overcast skylight and a narrow brass reflection reveal native skin and pigment surface texture.
baseline_prompt_en: One continuous photographic art-performance portrait: an adult art performer conducts a still appearance-and-surface inspection in a glass-roof botanical workroom. She is a fictional 27-year-old woman. Reference guidance comes from the supplied face and hair appearance. Her short dark bob has fine separated bangs, and her calm direct gaze acknowledges the camera. Her head and torso face forward on the same plane; her arms rest loosely beside her body as she stands upright. Each transparent theatrical contact lens bears one tiny opaque crimson heart centered over the visible black pupil region; each surrounding brown iris, sclera and eyelid retains its ordinary eye structure. The artificial lens prints are clearly resolved in both open eyes. A deep-blue abstract pigment marking sits on her own bare lower abdominal skin, its center four centimeters directly below her visible navel, with its entire six-centimeter width above the trouser waistband. The pigment follows the shallow curved skin surface and preserves visible pores and a gentle sideward falloff. This deliberately chosen marking has four disconnected elements: one closed central diamond, two mirrored open C-curves facing the diamond, and one short vertical stem below it. A boxy ivory sleeveless utility top ends above the navel; slate canvas work trousers sit below the marking. The scene records the freshly applied pigment settling. Beside her, a shallow tray on the plant bench holds the matching four cut-paper shapes and a capped blue paint bottle; a small brass plate catches a narrow amber reflection. Diffuse overcast skylight softly separates her from ribbed glass, leaves and worn timber. The crown-to-upper-hips composition gives equal reading space to her face and lower-abdominal marking, with both eyes and skin pigment sharply legible at native resolution. Fine photographic skin texture, neutral color and restrained workshop detail keep this a quiet material experiment.
